description: A beautiful beach located in the north of Goa, which is 28.9 km from Panaji. The best way to get here is by renting a car or a bike. This beach is famous for water sports like windsurfing, water-skiing, parasailing, jet skiing, motorbiking, and so on. Install the Goa app on your device to book your sport now! And get amazing prices on some of the best water sports. Some of the best things to experience in Mandrem are activities, attractions and historical monuments. Here you won’t find much beach shacks, but there are a few restaurants close by. Top sights to visit at Mandrem: -Mandrem Garden Beach -Shree Mhalasa Devi Temple Get a full body massage by and relax while the mesmerizing sound of waves hit the shore. Spend your evenings by taking a dip into the deep blue waters and watch the sunset with your friends or family. Rest the night at the resorts or the beach huts and wake up for another amazing adventure that waits ahead. How To Reach Mandrem Beach By Air Booking your flights to Goa International Airport or Dabolim Airport will be the ideal choice if you wish to experience a smooth journey. Mandrem Beach and Goa Airport are separated by approximately 55.8 kilometres. From the airport, it will take around 1 hour and 50 minutes to travel this distance by taxi, bus, or auto-rickshaw. How To Reach Mandrem Beach By Road Given that Mandrem Beach is in North Goa, all areas of Goa may readily access it. In addition, you can go to Mandrem beach areas from major cities like Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, etc. by a variety of public and private bus services. You may drive yourself or use a cab to get to Mandrem Beach thanks to the well-built motorways and roads in the area. How To Reach Mandrem Beach By Rail It's a smart idea to take the train to get to Mandrem Beach Place. This is due to the fact that Mandrem Beach is close to a lot of railroad stations. Pernem Station, located 12.5 kilometers from Mandrem Beach, and Thivim Station, located 17.8 km away, are the closest railroad stations. Vasco Da Gama, Kudal, Madgaon, and Karmali are more neighboring railroad stops. You may find taxis, cabs, or auto-rickshaws outside of every train station that will take you to Mandrem beach in North Goa. How To Reach Mandrem Beach From Panaji There are two alternative ways to get to Mandrem beach from Panaji: via bus, cab, or self-driving. 34 km is roughly how far it is from Panaji to Mandrem. Thus, your options are to take a bus, which would cost you about INR 70, or a cab, which will cost you INR 700–800. Each of the two choices will only require 40–45 minutes to travel this distance. Best Time To Visit Mandrem Beach Mandrem Beach boasts a wide range of hues throughout the year. Yet, one of the greatest seasons to visit Mandrem beach North Goa is during the delightful winter season, which lasts from November to March. The interaction between the frigid winds and the sun's warm ways makes your holiday feel even more enjoyable. Also, the temperature ranges from 21 to 32 degrees Celsius, which again makes it perfect for a wide variety of enjoyable activities. This season allows you to embrace everything, whether you wish to partake in water sports at Mandrem Beach, admire the sunset, or simply lounge about. Things to do: -Get a full body massage by and relax while the mesmerizing sound of waves hit the shore. -Spend your evenings by taking a dip into the deep blue waters and watch the sunset with your friends or family. -Rest the night at the resorts or the beach huts and wake up for another amazing adventure that waits ahead.
